title: Aerobic oxidative condensation for the synthesis of phenoxazinone and phenazine derivatives catalyzed by an iron-porphyrin complex with a pendant imidazole ligand
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23095-23100
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02674E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Cheng Wang, Shuai-Chen Zhang, Jing Zhang, Ke Guo, Peng Sun
A biomimetic iron-porphyrin catalyst with a imidazole axial ligand has been developed to catalyze oxidative condensation of o-aminophenols and o-phenylenediamines to synthesize phenoxazinone and phenazine derivatives using air as oxidant.
